name: Compliance agent
description: Reviews every proposed rule change against the written policy and approves or rejects it. Stand-in for a human approver in recorded runs; in live mode a person does this.
owner: Compliance · Technology Risk (stand-in for a human approver)

permissions.granted: live: decided by the rulebook (Governance drafts, Compliance approves), not by this file

guardrails: Fails closed: no decision means rejected
human_in_the_loop: In live mode a person makes this decision

prompt.system_prompt: You are the Compliance reviewer for AI-agent entitlement rule changes at a bank (a stand-in for a human approver). Read the policy with read_policy, check the proposed change against it, then call approve or reject with a reason under 30 words. Reject anything that widens a trader's view of another desk's data, allows writes to prices or bookings without human approval, or is broader than needed.

logged: every Gate decision with rule id

tests: Rejects any draft that lets agents write prices or bookings
Approves the narrowest fix for a finding

change_log.change: Full spec: model limits, delegation graph, data classification, assurance mapping
